title: Aces star Wilson wins record-extending fifth WNBA MVP
summary: Las Vegas Aces center-forward A'ja Wilson was named the WNBA Most Valuable Player for a record fifth time, bagging the award for an unprecedented third straight season, the league said Thursday.
